A new poll from The Economist/YouGov shows Democrats have an 8-point lead on a generic House ballot. The polling also found that President Trump's approval rating dropped to 33%. MS NOW Senior Editor and Opinion Columnist Anthony Fisher, Democratic strategist Basil Smikle, independent journalist Ahmed Baba and CNBC Fast Money Contributor Dan Nathan join Antonia Hylton to share their analysis as the midterms inch closer.

In Marquette's August poll, 46% of registered voters preferred Democrats on the generic ballot, compared with 44% for Republicans. results.content: Recent polling data, however, suggests challenges for the GOP. A national Economist/YouGov poll released on August 4 shows Democrats leading Republicans by 8 points on the generic ballot. Additionally, Trump's approval rating has fallen to 36%, with 60% disapproving of his performance as president.
